business_summary: Chongqing Rural Commercial Bank Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides banking and related financial services in the People's Republic of China. It operates through Corporate Banking, Personal Banking, and Financial Market Operations segments. The Corporate Banking segment offers current accounts, deposits, overdrafts, loans, and trade-related products, as well as engages in foreign currency and other credit services for corporations, government agencies, and financial institutions. Its Personal Banking segment provides personal loans, deposit products, cards, personal wealth management services, and other types of personal intermediary services to individual customers. The Financial Market Operations segment engages in money market or repurchase transaction services. It also provides financial leasing; personal, corporate, and micro finance; investment; and e-banking services. The company provides its services through its head office and business departments, branches, first-class sub-branches, second-class sub-branches, branch offices, off-site branches, and village and township banks, as well as smart integrated counters, automatic teller machines, and rural convenience financial self-service outlets. The company was formerly known as Chongqing Rural Credit Cooperative and changed its name to Chongqing Rural Commercial Bank Co., Ltd., in June 2008. Chongqing Rural Commercial Bank Co., Ltd. was founded in 1951 and is headquartered in Chongqing, China.
business_summary_ko: Chongqing Rural Commercial Bank Co., Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 중화인민공화국에서 은행 및 관련 금융 서비스를 제공합니다. 기업 뱅킹, 개인 뱅킹 및 금융 시장 운영 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 기업 금융 부문은 당좌 계좌, 예금, 당좌 차월, 대출 및 무역 관련 상품을 제공할 뿐만 아니라 기업, 정부 기관 및 금융 기관을 위한 외화 및 기타 신용 서비스도 제공합니다. 개인뱅킹 부문은 개인 고객에게 개인 대출, 예금 상품, 카드, 개인 자산 관리 서비스 및 기타 유형의 개인 중개 서비스를 제공합니다. 금융시장운영부문은 단기금융시장이나 환매거래 서비스를 영위합니다. 또한 금융리스도 제공합니다. 개인, 기업 및 소액 금융; 투자; 그리고 전자금융 서비스. 회사는 본점 및 영업부서, 지점, 1급지점, 2급지점, 지점, 외지점, 마을은행, 읍면은행, 스마트종합창구, 현금자동입출금기, 농촌편의점 등을 통해 서비스를 제공하고 있습니다.
